rationale: Total revenue when tagged; also used by banks for total net revenue.
Utilities' total operating revenue (e.g. NextEra). Ranked above ASC 606 tags, which are a subset for utilities.
Total net revenue for some broker-dealers and banks.
ASC 606 (2018+) revenue from contracts, net of sales taxes. Used only when no total tag exists: it excludes non-contract revenue (leases, derivatives, alternative revenue).
ASC 606 revenue including pass-through taxes (e.g. excise taxes).
Pre-2018 total sales tag, deprecated with ASC 606.
Pre-2018 product sales; only used when no total exists (may understate service revenue).
Total cost of revenue.
Post-2018 total cost of goods and services.
Pre-2018 tag. Excluded: CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciation... (different definition, would overstate gross profit) and CostOfServices (often only one component).
Reported gross profit. Derived as revenue minus cost of revenue when absent.
Only accepted tag; companies without it (most financials) get no operating income rather than a guess.
Attributable to parent. Rejected: ProfitLoss (includes NCI) and NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic (after preferred dividends).
Diluted EPS.
Used by companies where basic equals diluted.
Weighted average diluted shares.
Used where basic equals diluted.
Total R&D.
R&D excluding acquired IPR&D; used only when the total is not tagged.
Total SG&A. Rejected: GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense alone (excludes selling and marketing).
Total assets.
Reported total liabilities (about 72% of companies). Otherwise derived.
Parent shareholders' equity.
Balance-sheet cash and equivalents.
Cash-flow-statement total incl. restricted cash; used only when the balance-sheet tag is missing.
Banks' cash line.
Long-term debt including current maturities.
Same scope plus finance leases; used when LongTermDebt is not tagged.
Total operating cash flow.
Continuing operations only; used when the total is not tagged.
Purchases of PP&E.
PP&E plus intangibles; used by companies that combine them.
All dividends paid.
Common dividends only; used when the total is not tagged.
Balance-sheet total.
Total equity incl. NCI. Otherwise derived as parent equity + NCI.
Non-controlling interest.
Non-current long-term debt.
Current maturities of long-term debt.
Banks' net interest income.
Banks' non-interest income.
Total temporary (mezzanine) equity incl. redeemable NCI. Added after the balance-sheet identity test showed it explains most gaps.
Redeemable NCI at carrying amount.
Redeemable NCI at fair value (REITs, asset managers).
Other redeemable NCI at fair value (e.g. REIT operating-partnership units).
Redeemable preferred NCI.
Other temporary equity (e.g. redeemable preferred stock).
Net income incl. NCI. Used to derive net_income for companies that never tag NetIncomeLoss (e.g. ITW).
NCI share of net income; subtracted from ProfitLoss.
